hooks.command: bash -c 'PLAN="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(pwd)}/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md"; if [ -f "$PLAN" ] && grep -qE "Status:\s*(IN_PROGRESS|PENDING)" "$PLAN" 2>/dev/null; then echo "Found IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md with in-progress or pending items. Consider resuming with /implement-plan."; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty" 2>/dev/null); else CMD="$INPUT"; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git commit"; then bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/lab-notebook-gate.sh"; exit $?; else exit 0; fi'
hooks.statusMessage: Lab-notebook gate: verifying entry before commit…
